officialDataset.scope: National surveyed land-lot polygons; GeoJSON snapshot
officialDataset.license: Official dataset page states free personal/commercial use under the Open Data Licence; informational, not a gate.

boundedPublicProbes.result: The API provides a download URL, not a bbox parcel response. The large snapshot was not downloaded.
Empty response envelope: no result rows or field schema returned for this GeoJSON dataset. The documented API is row search/pagination and exposes no spatial bbox parameter.
LandLot is documented as a map/tile/WMS layer; capabilities do not advertise the layer as queryable.

boundedPublicProbes.operation: One-pixel GetFeatureInfo on LandLot using advertised text/plain format
boundedPublicProbes.result: No feature-info attributes or parcel geometry returned. A single pixel cannot provide a complete bbox parcel query in any case.

documentedAlternatives.dataGovDownload: Official API supports downloadable file subsets by row/column filters, but no spatial filter is documented for this GeoJSON. It is not a bbox adapter. Exact LOT_KEY filtering through the download API was not tested.
documentedAlternatives.slaDigitisedCadastre: Official SLA page offers cadastral datasets through enterprise licensing in DGN, DXF, DMP, or SHP; no public small-subregion feature endpoint was documented.
documentedAlternatives.oneMapLandLot: Official OneMap docs list LandLot as XYZ tiles, TileJSON, Mapbox style, and WMS map service; none supplies polygon feature batches with LOT_KEY exact lookup.

technicalBlockers: The public data.gov.sg dataset is a large snapshot download rather than a published spatial-query service.
No official small-area vector export or bbox-plus-exact-LOT_KEY endpoint was found in the documented SLA/OneMap services.
description: Current Singapore source assessment from official data.gov.sg and OneMap public API probes; metadata only, no parcel coordinates, geometries, or raw parcel identifiers.
